errors.evidence: The y-axis has no visible label. The description correctly infers the meaning of the axis from the title but incorrectly states that it is explicitly labeled.
The value at x=0 is visually around 1.84, which is clearly below the 1.9 axis mark. The reference states it is 1.85.
The value at x=2 is below 1.6, approximately 1.57 according to the reference and visual inspection.

errors.text_span: 在x=4至x=26之间基本保持在1.55至1.6之间波动
errors.evidence: The values in this range are all below 1.6. In fact, they are all below approximately 1.56 and decrease to around 1.51. The stated range of [1.55, 1.6] is incorrect.
The value at x=28 is approximately 1.50. The value 1.4 is significantly lower than the actual data point.

The description omits the very sharp drop between x=0 (value ~1.84) and x=1 (value ~1.58), which is one of the most significant features of the plot. It jumps from describing the point at x=0 to the one at x=2.

The description completely omits the final data point after x=28, which represents the overall 'voting' result and is the lowest point on the entire graph (at approximately 1.42, or 1.39 according to the reference).
